name: Sirocco
description_short: Waterfront dining on Thesen Island serving Mediterranean-inspired dishes with Knysna Lagoon views.
description_long:
Sirocco sits right on the water's edge of Thesen Island, offering diners sweeping views across the Knysna Lagoon. The spacious deck and modern interior make it equally suited for lazy lunches or sundowner sessions with friends. The menu leans Mediterranean with plenty of fresh seafood, wood-fired pizzas, and generously portioned pastas that keep locals coming back.

The location is hard to beat — you're watching boats drift past while tucking into calamari or their popular line fish of the day. It's relaxed enough for families during the day, with space for kids to move around, yet holds its own as an evening spot when the lagoon lights up. Service is friendly without fuss, and the wine list covers the basics well.

Thesen Island itself is worth exploring before or after your meal, with boutiques and walkways along the water. Sirocco fits comfortably into that laid-back Knysna vibe — nothing pretentious, just solid food in a spot that reminds you why people love this town.
